{{Short description|Swedish mathematician (born 1956)}}
'''Arne Meurman''' (born 6 April 1956) is a [[Sweden|Swedish]] [[mathematician]] working on [[finite group]]s and [[vertex operator algebra]]s. He is a [[emeritus|professor emeritus]] at [[Lund University]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Arne Meurman |url=https://portal.research.lu.se/en/persons/arne-meurman |website=Research Portal |publisher=[[Lund University]] |access-date=12 September 2025}}</ref>

He is best known for constructing the [[monster vertex algebra]] together with [[Igor Frenkel]] and [[James Lepowsky]].

In his free time Meurman plays chess, and he has competed in the finals of the top division in the regional [[Allskånskan]] competition with Lunds ASK.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-11-06 |title=Spelet Al-Jabar |url=https://www.maths.lu.se/english/research/staff/sonjakovalevsky2015/matematiska-verkstaeder/spelet-al-jabar/ |access-date=2024-09-21 |publisher=[[Lund University]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Falk |first=Ingemar |date=2024-04-23 |title=Limhamns SK blev skånska mästare efter sex timmars kamp |url=https://schack.se/nyhet/distrikt-och-klubb/2024/04/limhamns-sk-blev-skanska-mastare-efter-sex-timmars-kamp/ |access-date=2024-09-21 |website=[[Swedish Chess Federation]] |language=sv-SE}}</ref>
